title: Termination of Payment Protection Coverage
content:
**Provision.** Payment Protection coverage terminates automatically, with no action by the borrower, when the protected loan is paid off, refinanced, settled or charged off (reason loan paid off or loan charged off), at the first due date after the primary covered person reaches the coverage end age (reason age limit reached), when the lifetime benefit limits of every covered event are used (reason maximum benefits paid), or when a death benefit is paid (reason death benefit paid, which takes precedence over loan paid off when the death benefit is what paid the loan off). Benefits already approved for months before the termination date are still paid. A plan whose free look ends with the plan still enrolled becomes active.

## Terminating events and the reason recorded

Each termination records why coverage ended and the date it ended.

| Event | Reason recorded |
|---|---|
| The protected loan is paid off, refinanced or settled | loan paid off |
| The protected loan is charged off | loan charged off |
| The first due date after the primary covered person reaches the plan's coverage end age | age limit reached |
| The lifetime benefit limits of every covered event are used | maximum benefits paid |
| A death benefit is paid | death benefit paid |

Where the loan is paid off by the death benefit itself, the reason recorded is death benefit paid, not loan paid off.

## Status of the plan

- A plan still in its free-look period (enrolled status) terminates when the loan closed or a death benefit was paid.
- A plan in active status terminates for any of the events in the table.
- When the free-look period ends and the plan is still enrolled, it becomes active.
- Termination is distinct from cancellation: termination happens without the borrower acting, while cancellation is the borrower's own decision.

## Points of judgement

- **Approved benefits.** A monthly benefit already approved for a month before the termination date is still paid after coverage ends.
- **Age limit.** The test is the age of the primary covered person; the end falls on a due date, the first due date after that person reaches the age.
- **Death on a loan that the benefit pays off.** One reason is recorded, death benefit paid.
